question: What Do You Think About Fashion?

answers.text: There is not a lot of ways that we have free choice in the world So fashion is one of those ways that people can actually, individualize, and take back thier control
I don’t have a favorite brand
I'm grateful that I don't have to worry about it, on more days than not I definitely have sentimental t-shirts
